planets.name: TOI-7166 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-7166 with a 12.9-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-7166 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-7166. Its orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
